root_cause_criterion.obligation: When `format == 1`, `Charset::get_glyph` must preserve the caller's `num_glyphs` bound when it dispatches into `u.format1.get_glyph`, so the subsequent format-1 range walk stays bounded by the admitted glyph count.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable format-1 wrapper branch receives the accepted glyph-count bound from `std_code_to_glyph()` but dispatches via `u.format1.get_glyph (sid)` with no bound argument. The fixed branch forwards that same `num_glyphs` value into `u.format1.get_glyph (sid, num_glyphs)`.

nodes.description: During the selected format-1 lookup, the `ranges[i]` comparison still executes after `glyph` has already reached or exceeded the admitted `num_glyphs` limit, so the walk has advanced past the valid charset coverage before dereferencing the next range entry.

edges.relation: The same accent SID selected at the format-1 dispatch site is the SID later compared against `ranges[i]` in the selected `Charset1_2::get_glyph` walk.
